description: This file defines core state management structures and classes for a SwiftUI app, including a generic Prism, Reducer, and Store classes, with extensions for logging and bindings. It appears to be a central part of the app's architecture, handling state, actions, and effects.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: An ObservableObject class managing application state with support for dispatching actions, effects, and derived stores.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Dispatches an action, triggering the reducer and handling effects.

methods.name: derived
methods.description: Creates a derived store with a subset or transformation of the state.

methods.name: binding
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI Binding to a specific piece of state, mapped to an action.
